definitions.explanation: A polite way to refer to an older brother.
Used to address a young man, similar to 'mister' in English.

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何歳|なんさい}→何歳：17594_nansai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How old is your older brother?

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いてみる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
お{兄|にい}さん、⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Excuse me, young man, could you tell me the way?

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧です。
examples.english: My older brother is an office worker.

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}さん、⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦くれません→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Excuse me, young man, could you help me?

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}した→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧。
examples.english: My older brother graduated from university.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧お{兄|にい}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いてみよう→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。

examples.english: I get along well with my older brother.

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}さん、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}としました→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Excuse me, young man, you dropped this.

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似|に}ています→似る：01159_niru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You look like your older brother.

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}さん、⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧、⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Excuse me, young man, is there a convenience store nearby?

notes:
お{兄|にい}さん is the polite term for 'older brother' and can also be used to address young men.

FAMILY TERM VARIANTS:
- お{兄|にい}さん: someone's older brother (polite, used for others')
- ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧: my older brother (humble, used for own)
- ⟦お{兄|にい}ちゃん→お兄ちゃん：22785_oniichan⟧: older brother (casual/affectionate)
- ⟦{兄貴|あにき}→兄貴：11623_aniki⟧: older brother (masculine, informal)

ADDRESSING STRANGERS:
Used to address young men you don't know, similar to 'young man' or 'mister' in English. Common when asking for help or getting attention.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦お{姉|ねえ}さん→お姉さん：02859_oneesan⟧: older sister (polite) / young woman
- ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧: younger brother
- ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧: younger sister
